messages:
marta: Quick QA note — when I open the invocation inspector with VoiceOver it reads the header as 'Invoke panel' then jumps to the param list out of visual order. Noticed on Mac + Safari. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ux/1953.png :eyes: ryan: ugh yeah i've seen that. i think the DOM order differs from the visual flow because of the toolbar reordering for mobile. can you repro with a simple case? marta: yup repro steps: 1) open playground, 2) select function, 3) click 'Invoke' (right sidebar), 4) press VO+RightArrow. Focus lands on the last button instead of the first param. samir: possible quick fix: ensure the sidebar header and close button have proper aria-hidden or tabindex=-1 and then set aria-describedby on the first meaningful control. also check role="dialog" with aria-modal on the container. olivia: copy + naming nits: the button says "Run" in some places and "Invoke" in others — confuses screen reader users. propose we standardize on "Invoke" in the playground but change label to "Execute (Invoke)" on hover/tooltips for clarity. ryan: agree on standardizing. accessibility-first rule: match visual label to accessible name. we should avoid tooltip-only explanations. marta: also color contrast: the timestamp badges in the run timeline are 3:4.5 ratio on certain themes. failing for AA. small tweak to #2b6cb0 -> #245a9a would fix it. samir: sharing a small snippet that helped in a similar modal: ```

Invoke function

Parameters editor. Use arrow keys to navigate.

``` samir: make sure interactive param rows use role="group" and aria-roledescription="parameter" so VO announces them consistently. olivia: UX flow thought: when a function has multiple call variants, the run-history entry should expose the variant name as part of the summary (screen reader: "Run 3, variant: summarize+images"). right now it's hidden behind a chevron. ryan: +1. maybe we add a visually-hidden with the variant for SR users. also add keyboard shortcut to expand most recent run (e.g., Cmd+I) noted in the help menu. marta: tests: can someone add a VoiceOver smoke test to CI for the inspector path? just basic assertions: open panel -> focus first param -> activate first button -> history updated. devex-bot: new issue created: DEVEX-1128 "Invoke inspector: VoiceOver focus order + copy standardization" — https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-1128 :white_check_mark: ryan: assigning to @samir & @olivia, i'll punt the color contrast to frontend theming. samir: i'll prototype the aria changes and push a tiny PR today. will include a short screencast for VO navigation. olivia: i'll update copy strings and examples in the design tokens doc. will post updated copy here for quick review. marta: thanks! once PR is up i can run VoiceOver and confirm. :thumbsup: ryan: timeline: aiming for patch release this week if no regressions. keep it small — aria attributes & copy only. marta: tiny follow-up — suggest the 'copy to prompt' action has clear aria-live feedback like "Copied parameters to prompt" so SR users get confirmation. currently they don't get anything. samir: good catch. i'll add aria-live="polite" on the toast. olivia: optional: consider renaming 'Invocation inspector' to 'Invocation panel' in the codebase to match product copy — reduces mismatch across builds. ryan: ok let's keep 'Invocation panel' in copy but use shorter CSS/IDs like 'invoke-panel' in code. congrats on a short but meaningful thread :tada:
